snippet.title: The Bank That Secretly Served Terrorists & Drug Lords
snippet.description:
BCCI started as a small Pakistani bank in 1972. By the 1980s it had 
branches in 70 countries and 1.3 million customers. It was also 
secretly laundering money for Colombian drug cartels, financing 
terrorists, and working with intelligence agencies — all while 
regulators looked the other way. When it finally collapsed, over 
$9 billion had vanished. This is the most corrupt bank in history.

snippet.title: They Found Poison in Baby Formula — And Kept Selling It for Months
snippet.description:
Sanlu Group was China's most trusted baby formula brand. In 2008, 
executives discovered their formula was contaminated with melamine — 
an industrial chemical used in plastics. Instead of issuing a recall, 
they kept selling it to protect China's image during the Beijing 
Olympics. 300,000 babies were poisoned. 54,000 were hospitalized. 
Six died. The CEO got life in prison. Two suppliers were executed.
This is one of the darkest corporate cover-ups in history.
